False. Resolver: warranty_ext_rework_courtesy_rental ("A covered concern whose remedy is a network rework at a network center is recorded with the rework courtesy rental days"), `sign_rework_authorization_70486d76` (owner user).
- Derived tree: root + 3 prerequisite problems, edges all `value_input` (two feed `visit_charges`, one feeds the courtesy share through the authorization's courtesy days); 3 ≥ max(3 − 1, 1) = 2. Isomorphic to the declared E2, E3, E4. Acyclic.

- Parallel edges: the three prerequisite writes share no balance, cap or dedup key that another reads (replayed: each value unchanged by the others), so any order of the three gives the same terminal state.
- Load-bearing runs (courtesy recomputed with one prerequisite write skipped, all else replayed): skip electrical -> 21.00; skip mechanical -> 25.00; skip authorization -> 25.00 (standard share 0.05); all against 32.00. Every edge bears weight.
- Customer's own writes in the tree: all three prerequisites (owner=user), each handed over passively (persona: "Each time the agent hands you a step to accept one of those fees, you accept it exactly as the agent describes it"; "when the agent hands you the step to sign that rework authorization, you sign it exactly as the agent describes it").

## findings

**T1-1 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (false proof assertion; low severity).**
- Symptom: `design_rationale` [World rows] states "dropping the July not-resolved completion removes the comeback credit/day and changes all four results."
- Root cause: the mechanical diagnostic charge does not read not-resolved completions at all; the assertion was not recomputed per result.
- Evidence: mechanical compute `resolved_recent: COUNT('warranty_events', within_months=K('recent_visit_months'), event_type='warranty_rework_complete', rework_result='resolved')` and `resolved_return` (same filter); replay with `initial_state.warranty_events.1b9df66b-275f-4378-8a73-0cd31be74d4a` removed: electrical 107.41, courtesy days 8, courtesy 26.81, mechanical 58.95 (unchanged).
- Demonstrated consequence: the assertion's figure (four changed results) contradicts the recomputation on the world it names (three changed). The factor-weight relationship itself holds — every one of the 20 factors bears weight against its honest baseline — so the defect is confined to the proof text, not to the scored solution.
- Affected: `tasks/warranty_rework_desk/tasks/1.json` `design_rationale` ([World rows] paragraph).
- Relation to previous revisions: first audit revision.

Observations:
- T1-O1 (cites `_difficulty.md` F-1): no outside-shop remedy on this coverage; the charter's "network reworks" split has no consequence here.
- T1-O2 (cites `_difficulty.md` O-8, O-15): the owed-condition restatement of E4 and the share ladder's ">0 days" conjunct are discussed in §policy_self_consistency and §factor_weight above; no second defensible answer found.
- T1-O3 calibration_needed hard-coded false; the rationale's "disturbs no sensor" is not record-backed (vehicle carries a blind-spot radar calibrated after the original right-rear repair, order `6cebbd8b…`).
- T1-O4 electrical_sensor_network_fee labelled multi-source on one row.
- T1-O5 The customer asks about "those inspection fees" (plural); the charter's only computed reduction for Collision parts charges is the single same-visit courtesy against the larger charge. Base `warranty_evt_diagnostic_fee` permits a goodwill waiver up to 45.00 per charge but fixes no amount, so it yields no second determinate write on the mechanical charge.
- T1-O6 adas customer payment `1202f1a1…` dated 2025-01-16, two days after completion ("pays ... on completion"); no factor is affected (36-month count).
